dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Significant and continuous narrowing of the visible body mass from the widest mid-point toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: A distinct localized indentation is visible on the left lateral margin approximately one-third of the way down the longitudinal axis from the anterior-most point.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; visible dorsal area is split between a high-intensity illuminated left side and a shadowed light-grey right side.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, longitudinal linear gradient between the high-reflectance white region and the low-reflectance shadowed region.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical lighting bisection of the dorsal plane creates a dual-tone appearance.
